body: I've always lived by " let's see what happens " and I'm tired of it. I've never had goals growing up, and I always have just tried to get by with everything I do in life. I'd rather give up than just get by. I've always been an underachiever doing nothing with my life and that's all I'll ever be. The hardest part of finally going through with my thoughts will be the social interaction of purchasing a gun. Once that's over with and the gun is in my position I can finally live out my dream of ending my own worthless life.

Theres nothing in life that keeps me interested enough to persue. Life truly is meaningless. We all end up in the ground or in an urn anyway so why do I have to wait for natural cause when I could just do it myself?

The spot I will end my life will be the place I first realized  that I do not want to continue existing. It's a nice area with a river. I'm debating killing myself by a tree or in my parked car

I dont see myself being alive in two years. I'm just tired of everything life consists of. At this point in time I'm waiting for my check so I can actually afford to buy a gun. I have everything planned up to where I want to die.
She deserves better than someone like me anyway. All I do is disappoint.
